title: Guard block halts at the input boundary
statement: Let $b$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a finite Boolean string, and let $j\in\mathbb N$ satisfy $j\le |x|$ and $|x|-j<b+1$. For any Boolean output string $out$, after $|x|-j+1$ steps of the guard machine with parameter $b$, started at position $j$ in phase zero, the configuration is halted at position $|x|$, with output unchanged.
